svg.text: Multiblock form of the Ammo Press. A production hall: feeder, a run of press bays, a packing station. Reads the same gregguns.ammoPress
lit = hatch tiers, white outline = controller tier
LAYERS (each grid is one layer from above; rows run front to back)
Press bay (3 long, repeat n = 2 to 8)
I GT item pipe casing (belt, any tier)
Footprint: 5 wide x 7 tall x (7 + 3n) long
Layers: feeder 6, press bay 6, packing station
Blocks: feeder 18 F, 40 A, 2 I; each bay 44 A,
2 M, 3 I; station 16 O, 67 A, 3 I
Controller: front of the feeder, middle,
second layer from the bottom (the ~ cell).
Input Bus (1+): on any F; hopper tops are the
Output Bus (1+): on the O cells of the back
Belt: one tier of GT item pipe casing for the
whole I line; mixed tiers fail.
Add press bays: n = 2 to 8, each 3 blocks long
Hologram stack size selects n; survival build
places feeder, bays in order, station.
A structure with fewer than 2 or more than 8
bays fails with a named error.
Parallels = 4 x n x tier (tier of the max
input voltage). HV: 48 at n = 4, 96 at n = 8.
Capped by the power the Energy Hatches supply.
tier 2: 256 rifle bullets per 3.4 s, about
4,500 a minute against 160 a minute from one
pollution/s proposal), Input Bus, Output Bus.
Source: docs/gregguns-spec/08-machines-production/multiblocks.md and machine-roster.md. Layouts are designs, not Java; figures marked proposal are not settled.
